description: Detect bulletproof hosting providers that rebrand following law enforcement or sanctions action. Identifies new hosting entities advertising the same IP ranges, same BGP ASN prefixes, or same upstream transit providers as recently sanctioned or seized BPH operations. Tracks the Garantex to Grinex and Aeza to Smart Digital/Datavice patterns. Bulletproof hosting providers under sanctions or law enforcement pressure follow predictable rebranding patterns — registering new corporate entities while retaining the same underlying network infrastructure. BGP route announcements, IP range allocations, and upstream transit provider relationships persist across rebrandings, providing durable detection signals. This rule monitors for new hosting entities that share ASN prefixes, IP CIDR blocks, or transit provider relationships with recently sanctioned or seized BPH operations within a 90-day window following enforcement action.
falsepositives: Legitimate IP range transfers between hosting providers
Normal BGP re-advertisement after provider changes

title: Election-Cycle Domain Registration Spike
description: Detect anomalous increases in domain registrations containing financial institution brand names or financial services keywords during election periods. Compares registration volumes against a 90-day rolling baseline, alerting on 3x+ increases within 30 days of scheduled elections. Integrates with election calendar data for predictive detection.
falsepositives: Legitimate financial marketing campaigns during election seasons
Political donation platform launches

title: Sanctions-Announcement Infrastructure Correlation
description: Detect correlations between OFAC/EU sanctions announcements and subsequent infrastructure changes. Identifies new domain registrations by sanctioned entity-linked registrars, IP block migrations, and new BGP announcements from previously quiet ASNs within 14 days of sanctions designation.
falsepositives: Coincidental infrastructure changes near sanctions dates
Legitimate registrar customer migration

title: Politically-Motivated DDoS Financial Sector Targeting
description: Detect Layer 7 DNS attack patterns targeting financial services infrastructure that correlate with geopolitical event timelines. Differentiates politically motivated DDoS from criminal extortion DDoS by examining claim attribution (Telegram channel claims), target selection patterns (geopolitically aligned targets), and timing correlation with political events.
falsepositives: Legitimate traffic spikes during financial events (market crashes, IPOs)
CDN misconfigurations causing query amplification

title: Pig Butchering Domain Infrastructure Clustering
description: Detect clusters of domains exhibiting pig butchering investment platform characteristics: similar page structures, cryptocurrency wallet integration, registration through privacy-protected registrars, hosted on known scam compound infrastructure IP ranges. Documents Funnull-pattern CNAME clustering.
falsepositives: Legitimate cryptocurrency investment platform launches
Fintech startup domain portfolios

title: Scam Compound Cryptocurrency Payment Infrastructure
description: Detect domain clusters with cryptocurrency payment page patterns (wallet address display, QR code generation, transaction verification) registered in bulk through shared registrar/nameserver infrastructure.
falsepositives: Legitimate cryptocurrency payment processors
Merchant crypto payment gateway deployments

title: BPH IP Block Migration Post-Sanctions
description: Detect IP address blocks previously associated with sanctioned or seized BPH providers appearing under new BGP announcements from different ASNs. Track continuity of malicious hosting through IP block ownership changes.
falsepositives: Legitimate IP range transfers between hosting providers
Normal BGP re-advertisement after acquisitions

title: Cloud Provider IP Abuse for BPH Resale
description: Detect patterns consistent with legitimate cloud provider IP blocks being resold for BPH: unusual CNAME density (100+ domains per IP), diverse domain registrants sharing the same cloud IP range, and high abuse-report-to-domain ratios. Documents Funnull-pattern indicators (332K domains across 548 CNAMEs).
falsepositives: Legitimate CDN customers with high domain count
SaaS platforms hosting multiple customer domains

title: CNAME Clustering for DGA Domain Networks
description: Detect anomalous CNAME record density where hundreds or thousands of apparently unrelated domains share CNAME chains terminating at a small number of infrastructure endpoints. Indicates centrally managed infrastructure reusing cloud or CDN providers for mass domain hosting.
falsepositives: Large CDN deployments (Cloudflare, Akamai)
Legitimate marketing platforms with many customer domains

title: CMLN Wallet Cluster Velocity
description: Detect cryptocurrency wallet clusters exhibiting CMLN operational characteristics: high transaction velocity (average processing time under 2 minutes), incoming transfers from multiple unrelated sources, and rapid outbound distribution to exchange or OTC wallets.
falsepositives: High-frequency trading bots
Legitimate payment processors with rapid settlement cycles

title: No-KYC Exchange Off-Ramp Pattern
description: Detect cryptocurrency flows matching the DPRK 45-day laundering cycle pattern: initial rapid distancing through DeFi protocols (days 1-5), integration through no-KYC exchanges (days 5-14), and off-ramping through Chinese OTC brokers (days 20-45). Temporal pattern matching against known laundering cycle timelines.
falsepositives: Legitimate DeFi users with complex multi-protocol strategies
Institutional rebalancing across multiple venues
